# `aitbc blockchain consensus status`

Show consensus mode, view, sequence, epoch, and fault tolerance for a chain.

## Usage

```bash
aitbc blockchain consensus status [OPTIONS]
```

## Options

| Option | Type | Default | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `--node-url` | text | `http://localhost:8202` | no | Blockchain node RPC URL <!-- check-ports: ignore --> |
| `--chain-id` | text | — | no | Chain ID to query consensus status for (default: CHAIN_ID or the node's own chain) |
| `--format` | choice | — | no | Output format |

## Examples

```bash
aitbc blockchain consensus status
```
